headline: World Bank Reports Pakistan's External Debt Nearly Doubled Over Decade
summary: Pakistan's external debt nearly doubled over a 10-year period, according to World Bank data.
why: Accumulated external debt burdens weigh on sovereign fiscal space, foreign exchange reserves, and macroeconomic stability in developing economies.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Rapid accumulation of external debt increases sovereign default risk and debt-servicing obligations.
